_doc: HB1 The Cousins (docs/HOMAGE_BOSSES.md section 4): tuning for the Cousins Round on Map 0 and the three bosses. Loaded as GLData.table("bosses/cousins"). Times in seconds, distances in metres, damage in HP (player 100, Ironhide 250). hp_base is solo; HP = hp_base x (1 + hp_player_step x (players - 1)) with players = RoundManager.players (MapRoot.scaled_player_count, bots at their weight). Speeds get +enrage_speed_step per dead cousin (stacking), and move cooldowns shrink by the same factor. Spoken lines have no baked audio yet (VO_SCRIPT section 12 is not extracted): 'lines' holds their subtitle text and the code falls back to subtitles silently.

bots_alone._doc: Squad scaling (user call 2026-10-22: the Cousins scale for bot-only squads). While no human is on their feet (solo with bots and the human down or bled out, or bots alone) the three take hp_mult of their health (the bar keeps its fraction), deal damage_mult damage, wait cooldown_mult as long between moves and move at speed_mult; the horde still queued is cut to horde_mult once per fight (the horde, not the three, downs bots while they focus the bosses). On after engage_after s without a human up, off release_after s after one is back.

lines._doc: Subtitle text for the Cousins' lines (VO_SCRIPT section 12 / HOMAGE_BOSSES section 8). speaker: OPR or the cousin slot (hammer / reach / alix / cousins), shown as the Homage Names name. twin = the unnamed line used when Homage Names is In-World.

CSN_CLAP_01.speaker: cousins
CSN_CLAP_01.text: [three pairs of hands clapping upstairs, in a rhythm, then stopping]

CSN_HUM_01.speaker: cousins
CSN_HUM_01.text: [the rhyme, hummed in three voices: Drei Kusinen unterm Haus...]

CSN_RETURN_01.speaker: cousins
CSN_RETURN_01.text: Bereit oder nicht, wir kommen! (Ready or not, here we come!)

HAM_ENRAGE_TWIN_01.speaker: hammer
HAM_ENRAGE_TWIN_01.text: Wo bist du? ...Komm raus! (Where are you? ...Come out!)

HAM_ALONE_01.speaker: hammer
HAM_ALONE_01.text: Jetzt sind nur noch ich. (Now there's only me.)

HAM_DEATH_01.speaker: hammer
HAM_DEATH_01.text: ...Ich mag nicht mehr spielen. (...I don't want to play any more.)

RCH_REEL_01.speaker: reach
RCH_REEL_01.text: Komm her. Komm her. Komm her. (Come here. Come here. Come here.)

RCH_HUG_01.speaker: reach
RCH_HUG_01.text: Halt still. Ganz still. (Hold still. Very still.)

RCH_WALL_01.speaker: reach
RCH_WALL_01.text: [a knock under the floorboards] Hier unten... (Down here...)

ALX_ARRIVE_01.speaker: alix
ALX_ARRIVE_01.text: [a whisper] Ich hab sie noch. Ich halt sie noch. (I've still got them. I'm still holding on.)

ALX_HOLD_02.speaker: alix
ALX_HOLD_02.text: Tante kommt gleich. Halt fest. (Auntie's coming soon. Hold tight.)

ALX_COUSIN_TWIN_01.speaker: alix
ALX_COUSIN_TWIN_01.text: Ich bin da. Ich bin ja da. (I'm here. I'm right here.)

ALX_ENRAGE_01.speaker: alix
ALX_ENRAGE_01.text: Ihr habt sie losgelassen. (You let go of her.)
